title: Mixed Event — Our Precious Memories — Episode6 An Evening Of Excitement

meta.Event Outline: As the Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy school year draws to a close, Saki revisits her "100 Things I Want To Do" list. She makes up her mind to cross off the whole list, especially No. 95: "Make lots of fun memories and put them in a photo album!"

rows.Line: A few days later
Saki's Room

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That chocolate fondue was so yummy!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Fish sausage and chocolate go together surprisingly well. It felt like I was gonna get hooked.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! It won our contest, “Curveball Competition: Which is the tastiest?”! Sweet potato had more points in the flavor category, but after adding in points for the surprise factor, the sausage won out...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup yup, it sure was a heated battle☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It was also really fun having Airi teach us to decorate with the chocolate pen and stuff♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe, that reminded me of the time we made chocolate Valentine's desserts together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, me too!
It made me happy to think the Secret Valentine's Day Alliance was back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Airi, Emu, thank you both so much for having this chocolate fondue party with me!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There's no need for that. When it comes to chocolate, this is the group to get together, right? I was happy to be making treats with you two again!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Me too, me too!
Let's do it again!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe... Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, huuuh?!
Our party went on for this long?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh? Do you have something going on after this, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah. I promised to hang out with Ichi and the others...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh? Then, we'd better hurry and get this all put away! As for the leftovers, let's split them up and each take some.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Okay!
bgm_area00001
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sorry I'm late, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki... There you are.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Are you okay? Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh, I'm sure she was just caught up picking out her pajamas or something.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I was not!
Actually, I was having a chocolate fondue party with Airi and Emu!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: When I told them about my list, they said they wanted to help me out. We made some great memories♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Here, I brought leftovers for you guys!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa, they look so good!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: By the way, how much of that list have you gotten through?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've completed most of the items thanks to everyone helping out! If I don't include the photo album... This one we're about to do is the last one!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Wait, really?!
Then we'll have to go all out☆

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Now then, without further ado...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The “All-Night Chat Sleepover☆in☆SEKAI” starts now!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO & Rin
rows.Line: Yay!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: But... What do you do at a sleepover?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You play games, chat and all that stuff until you start to feel sleepy! And so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ta-da!
I prepared this!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: A dice and...a notepad?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! There are conversation topics written in the notepad, so we roll the dice and talk about the topic that comes up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: MMJ did this on stream before, and I've been wanting to try it!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oooh, sounds fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But these conversation topics... What sorts are there?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's see... “A story that's sure to get laughs”, “a time you felt so embarrassed you wanted to disappear”, “a secret you can only reveal now that enough time has passed”...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Are you being serious right now...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
Still, I'm sure it'll be fun getting to see an unexpected side to everyone.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay, today's top batter is...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Huh?! Me?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can do it, Honami!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: With this sort of thing, going first will make it less stressful.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: W-Will it really...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
But... If I don't do it, we can't start...!
Please land on something easy to answer... There!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And we have our result!
Time to hear a secret that Hona can only reveal to us now!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: A secret? U-Um...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: S-So, the last time we all had apple pie at my house, I gave everyone slices, but those were actually from a whole pie...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: And everything I didn't serve to all of you, I ate myself...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Next is... A time MEIKO had the daylights shocked out of her!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
The other day, I was playing the drums alone...
I was building up, building up to the end of the song, and when the last hit of the cymbal rang out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I saw something...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Saw...what...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: She saw me jump out of the locker with a “ta-da!”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: S-So that was all...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I didn't think you would have that sort of embarrassing story, KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Well, don't let it get to you.
Everyone's stumbled on the rail of a sliding door before.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Ahh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I guess everyone's talked now...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, we made it all the way around?!
That was too fast, let's go around one more time!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it's already pretty late, you know?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah. It'll probably be tough work getting all the bedding laid out, so don't you think we should start getting ready to sleep soon?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh... Okaaay...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, let's move these desks and chairs aside and lay out the bedding.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Nice, the bedding's looking good!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Now all that's left is to sleep.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Once we fall asleep, our sleepover's gonna end... That's kinda sad, but... This was fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It was...
Plus, now you're pretty much done going through the list of things you wanted to do, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Now I just need to make the photo album!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I have lots of pictures thanks to everyone's help, so I'll make them into the best album ever!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Hey, Saki.
Actually, there's something we wanted to give you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's these...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They're...pictures?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...! They're all from when I was doing the stuff on my list...! So you guys were taking pictures for me too!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. But it's not just that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We took them so you'd be the focus.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Shiho noticed something.
She pointed out that there weren't many good shots of you in the pictures you were getting together for your album.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, there weren't...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. Don't you think it'd be a shame if you went to the trouble of making the album and it didn't have any pictures of you having fun?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: That's why I thought you should also include some pictures where you're the focus.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Shiho... You guys...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you!!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Whoa...!
se_event_preciousmemories_2023_009

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hahaha!
Saki, you went full steam ahead!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
They took a dive into the bedding!
That looks fun! I wanna try tooo!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Geez... Saki, you know that was dangerous...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, but I was just so happy♪

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah... Well, we were about to sleep anyway, so I guess I'll stay where I am and do just that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe, we should get settled as well.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, KAITO and I'll be heading over to the classroom next door.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Good night.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Good niiight!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hehe♪
It's kinda exciting sleeping in the same room as everyone else!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
You're right.
I guess it'd be kind of a shame to just fall asleep right away.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh... Then, Saki, could you show us the pictures everyone gave you?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That would be wonderful.
I want to hear all about the memories they represent too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sure!
Okay, which one to talk about...? Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, this one! This is of the time we ate crepes on Takeue Street! So you were taking pictures here, too!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We took it while you were lost in your crepe.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Haha!
It does look like she's really enjoying it.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe, her mouth's open so wide.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah... But Shiho totally didn't notice that she had whipped cream on her nose!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey now. I said to forget about that, didn't I?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I expertly captured whipped-cream-Shiho, so I will never forget it!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't put it in the album, alright...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ohhh? What to do, what to do...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mrgh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Heh...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Saki fell asleep...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. She'll probably pout tomorrow when she finds out she was the first to fall asleep.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Well, she did drift off while chatting, so doesn't that mean she accomplished what she wanted to do during this sleepover?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Mhm... I can't drink any more chocolate...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What kind of dream is she having...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: She looks to be sleeping very happily.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: She does...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Good night, Saki.
